<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/csv.php';

const FAMILIES = ['Tapis de course', 'Vélos', 'Elliptiques & cardio', 'Rameurs', 'Musculation', 'Pilates & yoga',
    'Accessoires', 'Padel & raquettes', 'Loisirs', 'Bien-être & médical', 'Pièces & entretien', 'Autres'];

/* ---------- Produits ---------- */

/** Prix appliqué en caisse (promo si elle est inférieure au prix régulier). */
function product_price(array $p): int
{
    $promo = $p['promo_price'] ?? null;
    if ($promo !== null && (int)$promo > 0 && ((int)$promo < (int)$p['price'] || (int)$p['price'] === 0)) return (int)$promo;
    return (int)$p['price'];
}

function product_image(array $p): string
{
    if (!empty($p['image'])) return $p['image'];
    return $p['image_url'] ?? '';
}

/* ---------- Stock ---------- */

function stock_qty(int $productId, int $locationId): int
{
    return (int)(val('SELECT qty FROM stock WHERE product_id = ? AND location_id = ?', [$productId, $locationId]) ?? 0);
}

/** Ajoute $delta au stock et trace le mouvement. Retourne la nouvelle quantité. */
function stock_change(int $productId, int $locationId, int $delta, string $type, string $ref = '', string $note = ''): int
{
    q('INSERT INTO stock(product_id, location_id, qty) VALUES (?, ?, 0) ON CONFLICT(product_id, location_id) DO NOTHING', [$productId, $locationId]);
    q('UPDATE stock SET qty = qty + ? WHERE product_id = ? AND location_id = ?', [$delta, $productId, $locationId]);
    $after = stock_qty($productId, $locationId);
    insert('stock_moves', [
        'created_at' => now(), 'product_id' => $productId, 'location_id' => $locationId, 'qty_change' => $delta,
        'qty_after' => $after, 'type' => $type, 'ref' => $ref, 'note' => $note, 'user_id' => $_SESSION['uid'] ?? null,
    ]);
    return $after;
}

/** Fixe la quantité (inventaire). Retourne l'écart appliqué. */
function stock_set(int $productId, int $locationId, int $qty, string $type = 'inventaire', string $note = ''): int
{
    $delta = $qty - stock_qty($productId, $locationId);
    if ($delta !== 0) stock_change($productId, $locationId, $delta, $type, '', $note);
    return $delta;
}

/* ---------- Nettoyage des textes WooCommerce ---------- */

function clean_text(string $html): string
{
    $s = str_replace(['\\n', '\\r'], ["\n", ''], $html);
    $s = preg_replace('/\[video[^\]]*\](\[\/video\])?/i', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('/\[\/?[a-z_]+[^\]]*\]/i', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('/<!--.*?-->/s', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#<img\b[^>]*>#i', '', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#<li\b[^>]*>#i', "\n• ", $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#</t[dh]>\s*<t[dh]\b[^>]*>#i', ' : ', $s);
    $s = preg_replace('#<(br|/p|/li|/h\d|/div|/tr|/ul|/ol|/blockquote|/section)\b[^>]*>#i', "\n", $s);
    $s = strip_tags($s);
    $s = html_entity_decode($s, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8');
    $s = preg_replace('/[\x{2066}-\x{2069}\x{FFFC}\x{200B}\x{FEFF}]/u', '', $s);
    $s = str_replace("\u{00A0}", ' ', $s);
    $out = [];
    foreach (preg_split('/\R/u', $s) as $line) {
        $line = trim(preg_replace('/[ \t]+/u', ' ', $line));
        if ($line === '•' || $line === "'-") $line = '';
        if (preg_match('/^Si tu veux, je peux aussi/i', $line)) continue;
        if ($line === '' && (empty($out) || end($out) === '')) continue;
        $out[] = $line;
    }
    while ($out && end($out) === '') array_pop($out);
    // pas de ligne vide entre deux puces
    $res = [];
    foreach ($out as $i => $line) {
        if ($line === '' && isset($out[$i - 1], $out[$i + 1]) && str_starts_with($out[$i - 1], '•') && str_starts_with($out[$i + 1], '•')) continue;
        $res[] = $line;
    }
    return implode("\n", $res);
}

function guess_family(string $cats, string $name): string
{
    $c = mb_strtolower($cats);
    $t = mb_strtolower($cats . ' ' . $name);
    if (preg_match('/pi[eè]ces de rechange|bande tapis|cle de securite|clé de sécurité|huile lubrifiant/u', $t)) return 'Pièces & entretien';
    if (preg_match('/tapis roulant|treadmill/u', $t)) return 'Tapis de course';
    if (preg_match('/ellipti|ellepti|climber/u', $t)) return 'Elliptiques & cardio';
    if (preg_match('/rameur|ski ?erg/u', $t)) return 'Rameurs';
    if (preg_match('/v[ée]lo|bike|spinning|biking|vtt/u', $t)) return 'Vélos';
    if (preg_match('/\bpilates\b|reformer|yoga/u', $t)) return 'Pilates & yoga';
    if (preg_match('/padel|ping ?pong|raquette/u', $t)) return 'Padel & raquettes';
    if (preg_match('/m[ée]dical|massage/u', $t)) return 'Bien-être & médical';
    if (preg_match('/skate|trampoline|balance board/u', $c)) return 'Loisirs';
    if (preg_match('/musculation|\bbanc\b|bench|machine|multifonction|multi exercice|leg |smith|station|halt[eè]re|dumbbell|trx|barre|crunch|curl|pec fly/u', $t)) return 'Musculation';
    return 'Accessoires';
}

function guess_brand(string $name, string $short): string
{
    $s = trim($short);
    if (preg_match('/^(SVELTUS|CARE|CORNILLEAU|CUBE|AWAII|ARK-ONE|ATHLI-TECK)$/i', $s, $m)) return mb_strtoupper($m[1]);
    $t = $name . ' ' . mb_substr($s, 0, 400);
    $rules = [
        '/body sculpture/i' => 'Body Sculpture', '/nordi[ck]tra[c]?k/i' => 'NordicTrack', '/impulse/i' => 'Impulse',
        '/pro[- ]?form/i' => 'ProForm', '/hit ?up/i' => 'Hit Up Sport', '/bab-?dida/i' => 'Bab-Dida', '/avon fitness/i' => 'Avon Fitness',
        '/bullpadel/i' => 'Bullpadel', '/babolat/i' => 'Babolat', '/\bBT\b|bt fitness/' => 'BT Fitness', '/\bCARE\b/' => 'CARE',
    ];
    foreach ($rules as $re => $b) if (preg_match($re, $t)) return $b;
    return '';
}

function guess_warranty(string $text): ?int
{
    if (preg_match('/garantie\s*:?\s*(\d{1,2})\s*ans?\b/iu', $text, $m)) return (int)$m[1] * 12;
    return null;
}

/* ---------- Import ---------- */

/**
 * Importe une ligne produit, au format WooCommerce (export du site) ou au format de l'ERP.
 * $r : ligne aux en-têtes normalisés (slug_key). $opts : stock_location (int|null), mode ('woo'|'erp').
 */
function product_import_row(array $r, array $opts): string
{
    $woo = ($opts['mode'] ?? '') === 'woo';
    $g = function (string ...$keys) use ($r): string {
        foreach ($keys as $k) if (isset($r[$k]) && trim((string)$r[$k]) !== '') return trim((string)$r[$k]);
        return '';
    };

    if ($woo) {
        $type = $g('type');
        if ($type !== '' && !in_array($type, ['simple', 'variable', 'variation', 'external', 'grouped'], true)) return 'skipped';
        $short = clean_text($g('description_courte'));
        $long = clean_text($g('description'));
        $name = trim(preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $g('nom')));
        if ($name === '') $name = mb_substr(strtok($short ?: '', "\n") ?: '', 0, 80);
        if ($name === '') return 'skipped';
        $brand = $g('marques') ?: guess_brand($name, $short);
        $desc = mb_strlen($short) >= 40 ? $short : ($long ?: $short);
        if (mb_strtoupper($desc) === mb_strtoupper($brand)) $desc = '';
        $published = $g('publie');
        $regular = parse_money($g('tarif_regulier'));
        $promo = parse_money($g('tarif_promo'));
        $images = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $g('images')))));
        $wooId = parse_int($g('id'));
        $local = $wooId && is_file(APP_ROOT . "/assets/img/products/$wooId.jpg") ? "assets/img/products/$wooId.jpg" : '';
        $cats = $g('categories');
        $data = [
            'woo_id' => $wooId,
            'sku' => $g('ugs'),
            'barcode' => $g('gtin_upc_ean_ou_isbn'),
            'name' => $name,
            'categories' => $cats,
            'price' => $regular ?? ($promo ?? 0),
            'promo_price' => ($promo !== null && $regular !== null && $promo < $regular) ? $promo : null,
            'description' => mb_substr($desc, 0, 3000),
            'image_url' => $images[0] ?? '',
            'web_status' => $published === '1' ? 'publie' : ($published === '-1' ? 'brouillon' : 'prive'),
            'active' => $published === '-1' ? 0 : 1,
        ];
        $existing = $wooId ? one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE woo_id = ?', [$wooId]) : null;
        if (!$existing && $data['sku'] !== '') $existing = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ? AND woo_id IS NULL', [$data['sku']]);
        $minStock = parse_int($g('montant_de_stock_faible'));
        if ($existing) {
            if ($local && !$existing['image']) $data['image'] = $local;
            if (!$existing['brand'] && $brand) $data['brand'] = $brand;
            if (!$existing['warranty_months']) $data['warranty_months'] = guess_warranty($short . "\n" . $long);
            $data['updated_at'] = now();
            update('products', $data, 'id = ?', [$existing['id']]);
            return 'updated';
        }
        $data += [
            'family' => guess_family($cats, $name), 'brand' => $brand, 'image' => $local,
            'warranty_months' => guess_warranty($short . "\n" . $long), 'min_stock' => $minStock ?? 0,
            'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
        ];
        $pid = insert('products', $data);
        $qty = parse_int($g('stock'));
        if ($qty !== null && $qty !== 0 && !empty($opts['stock_location'])) {
            stock_change($pid, (int)$opts['stock_location'], $qty, 'import', 'CSV site', 'Stock indiqué dans l’export du site');
        }
        return 'created';
    }

    // Format ERP (export de cette application) : $r est indexé par les clés du jeu de données « produits »
    $name = $g('name');
    if ($name === '') throw new RuntimeException('Nom du produit manquant');
    $id = parse_int($g('id'));
    $wooId = parse_int($g('woo_id'));
    $sku = $g('sku');
    $existing = $id ? one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$id]) : null;
    if (!$existing && $wooId) $existing = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE woo_id = ?', [$wooId]);
    if (!$existing && $sku !== '') $existing = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ?', [$sku]);
    $price = parse_money($g('price'));
    $family = $g('family');
    if ($family !== '' && !in_array($family, FAMILIES, true)) {
        foreach (FAMILIES as $f) if (slug_key($f) === slug_key($family)) $family = $f;
    }
    $active = $g('active');
    $data = ['name' => $name];
    foreach (['sku', 'barcode', 'brand', 'categories', 'description', 'image_url'] as $k) {
        if (array_key_exists($k, $r)) $data[$k] = $g($k);
    }
    if ($family !== '') $data['family'] = $family;
    if ($price !== null) $data['price'] = $price;
    if (array_key_exists('promo_price', $r)) $data['promo_price'] = parse_money($g('promo_price'));
    if (array_key_exists('cost', $r) && ($opts['can_cost'] ?? false)) $data['cost'] = parse_money($g('cost'));
    if (($w = parse_int($g('warranty_months'))) !== null) $data['warranty_months'] = $w;
    if (($ms = parse_int($g('min_stock'))) !== null) $data['min_stock'] = $ms;
    if ($active !== '') $data['active'] = in_array(mb_strtolower($active), ['1', 'oui', 'yes', 'true', 'actif', 'o'], true) ? 1 : 0;
    if ($wooId) $data['woo_id'] = $wooId;
    $data['updated_at'] = now();
    if ($existing) {
        update('products', $data, 'id = ?', [$existing['id']]);
        return 'updated';
    }
    if ($price === null) throw new RuntimeException('Prix de vente manquant pour « ' . $name . ' »');
    $data += ['family' => guess_family($data['categories'] ?? '', $name), 'created_at' => now()];
    insert('products', $data);
    return 'created';
}

/** Import initial (installation) du fichier exporté depuis WooCommerce. */
function catalog_import_woo_file(PDO $pdo, string $file): array
{
    $csv = csv_read_file($file);
    $count = ['created' => 0, 'updated' => 0, 'skipped' => 0];
    $dep = (int)(val("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE code = 'DEP'") ?? 0);
    foreach ($csv['rows'] as $row) {
        $res = product_import_row($row, ['mode' => 'woo', 'stock_location' => $dep ?: null]);
        $count[$res]++;
    }
    return $count;
}

function csv_is_woo(array $headers): bool
{
    return in_array('tarif_regulier', $headers, true) || in_array('ugs', $headers, true);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Lit un fichier CSV (UTF-8 ou Windows-1252, séparateur ; , ou tabulation détecté automatiquement).
 * Retourne ['headers' => [clés normalisées], 'labels' => [en-têtes d'origine], 'rows' => [[clé => valeur]], 'delimiter' => ...].
 */
function csv_read_file(string $file): array
{
    $raw = (string)file_get_contents($file);
    if (strncmp($raw, "\xEF\xBB\xBF", 3) === 0) $raw = substr($raw, 3);
    if (!mb_check_encoding($raw, 'UTF-8')) $raw = mb_convert_encoding($raw, 'UTF-8', 'Windows-1252');
    $firstLine = strtok($raw, "\n") ?: '';
    $counts = [';' => substr_count($firstLine, ';'), ',' => substr_count($firstLine, ','), "\t" => substr_count($firstLine, "\t")];
    arsort($counts);
    $delim = (string)array_key_first($counts);

    $fh = fopen('php://temp', 'r+');
    fwrite($fh, $raw);
    rewind($fh);
    $labels = fgetcsv($fh, 0, $delim, '"', '') ?: [];
    $labels = array_map(fn($h) => trim((string)$h), $labels);
    $headers = array_map('slug_key', $labels);
    $rows = [];
    $line = 1;
    while (($r = fgetcsv($fh, 0, $delim, '"', '')) !== false) {
        $line++;
        if ($r === [null] || (count($r) === 1 && trim((string)$r[0]) === '')) continue;
        $row = [];
        foreach ($headers as $i => $h) {
            if ($h === '') continue;
            $row[$h] = isset($r[$i]) ? (string)$r[$i] : '';
        }
        $row['__line'] = $line;
        $rows[] = $row;
    }
    fclose($fh);
    return ['headers' => $headers, 'labels' => $labels, 'rows' => $rows, 'delimiter' => $delim];
}

/** Envoie un CSV compatible Excel (UTF-8 avec BOM, séparateur point-virgule). */
function csv_send(string $filename, array $labels, iterable $rows): void
{
    header('Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8');
    header('Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"');
    header('Cache-Control: no-store');
    $out = fopen('php://output', 'w');
    fwrite($out, "\xEF\xBB\xBF");
    fputcsv($out, $labels, ';', '"', '');
    foreach ($rows as $r) {
        fputcsv($out, array_map(fn($v) => is_null($v) ? '' : (string)$v, array_values($r)), ';', '"', '');
    }
    fclose($out);
    exit;
}

/** Montant pour un CSV : 1999,000 (virgule décimale, lisible par Excel en français). */
function csv_money($m): string
{
    return $m === null || $m === '' ? '' : number_format(((int)$m) / 1000, 3, ',', '');
}

function csv_bool($v): string
{
    return $v ? 'oui' : 'non';
}

function csv_yes($v): bool
{
    return in_array(mb_strtolower(trim((string)$v)), ['1', 'oui', 'o', 'yes', 'y', 'true', 'vrai', 'x'], true);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/*
 * Jeux de données importables / exportables en CSV.
 * Chaque entrée : label, help, export (permission ou liste), import (permission|null),
 * cols (clé => en-tête), rows(filtres) => itérable, import_row(ligne, options) => created|updated|skipped.
 */

function loc_from_text(string $s): ?int
{
    $s = trim($s);
    if ($s === '') return null;
    foreach (locations(false) as $l) {
        if (strcasecmp($l['code'], $s) === 0 || slug_key($l['name']) === slug_key($s) || (string)$l['id'] === $s) return (int)$l['id'];
    }
    throw new RuntimeException("Site « $s » inconnu (codes : " . implode(', ', array_column(locations(false), 'code')) . ').');
}

function user_from_text(string $s): ?int
{
    $s = trim($s);
    if ($s === '') return null;
    $id = val('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ? OR name = ? COLLATE NOCASE', [$s, $s]);
    return $id ? (int)$id : null;
}

function key_from_label(array $map, string $s, string $default): string
{
    $s = trim($s);
    if ($s === '') return $default;
    if (isset($map[$s])) return $s;
    foreach ($map as $k => $label) if (slug_key($label) === slug_key($s) || slug_key($k) === slug_key($s)) return $k;
    return $default;
}

function product_from_row(array $r): ?array
{
    if (($id = parse_int($r['id'] ?? '')) && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$id]))) return $p;
    if (($wid = parse_int($r['woo_id'] ?? '')) && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE woo_id = ?', [$wid]))) return $p;
    if (trim($r['sku'] ?? '') !== '' && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = ?', [trim($r['sku'])]))) return $p;
    if (trim($r['name'] ?? '') !== '' && ($p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE name = ? COLLATE NOCASE', [trim($r['name'])]))) return $p;
    return null;
}

function export_scope(array $f): ?int
{
    $s = scope_loc();
    return $s ?? ((int)($f['loc'] ?? 0) ?: null);
}

            'source' => 'Origine', 'campaign' => 'Campagne', 'product' => 'Article', 'sku' => 'Référence', 'family' => 'Famille', 'qty' => 'Quantité',

                    $r['label'], $r['sku'], $r['family'], $r['qty'], csv_money($r['list_price']), csv_money($r['unit_price']), csv_money($r['line']),

            $data = ['name' => $name, 'type' => slug_key($r['type'] ?? '') === 'interne' ? 'interne' : 'externe'];
            foreach (['phone', 'contact', 'zones', 'notes'] as $k) if (isset($r[$k])) $data[$k] = trim($r[$k]);

    $ds['livraisons'] = [

        'cols' => ['number' => 'N° livraison', 'sale' => 'N° vente', 'loc' => 'Départ', 'recipient' => 'Destinataire', 'phone' => 'Téléphone', 'gouvernorat' => 'Gouvernorat',

function ds_can(array $d, string $what): bool
{
    $perm = $d[$what] ?? null;
    if (!$perm) return false;
    foreach ((array)$perm as $p) if (can($p)) return true;
    return false;
}

/** Envoie l'export CSV d'un jeu de données. */
function ds_export(string $key, array $f, bool $templateOnly = false): void
{
    $d = datasets()[$key] ?? null;
    if (!$d || !ds_can($d, $templateOnly ? 'import' : 'export')) {
        http_response_code(403);
        exit('Export non autorisé.');
    }
    $cols = $d['cols'];
    if ($key === 'produits' && !is_admin()) unset($cols['cost']);
    $rows = $templateOnly ? [] : (function () use ($d, $f, $key) {
        foreach ($d['rows']($f) as $r) {
            if ($key === 'produits' && !is_admin()) unset($r[9]);
            yield array_values($r);
        }
    })();
    $name = $key . ($templateOnly ? '-modele' : '') . (!empty($d['dates']) && !$templateOnly ? '-' . $f['from'] . '_' . $f['to'] : '') . '-' . date('Ymd-Hi') . '.csv';
    if (!$templateOnly) audit('export CSV', $key, null, $d['label']);
    csv_send($name, array_values($cols), $rows);
}

/** Importe (ou simule) un fichier. Retourne un rapport. */
function ds_import(string $key, string $file, bool $commit, array $opts): array
{
    $d = datasets()[$key] ?? null;
    if (!$d || !ds_can($d, 'import')) throw new RuntimeException('Import non autorisé.');
    $csv = csv_read_file($file);
    $woo = $key === 'produits' && csv_is_woo($csv['headers']);
    $map = [];
    foreach ($d['cols'] as $k => $label) {
        $map[slug_key($label)] = $k;
        $map[slug_key($k)] = $k;
    }
    $unknown = [];
    $known = [];
    if (!$woo) {
        foreach ($csv['headers'] as $i => $h) {
            if ($h === '') continue;
            if (isset($map[$h])) $known[] = $map[$h];
            else $unknown[] = $csv['labels'][$i];
        }
        if (!$known) throw new RuntimeException('Aucune colonne reconnue. Téléchargez le modèle CSV pour voir les en-têtes attendus.');
    }
    $report = ['created' => 0, 'updated' => 0, 'skipped' => 0, 'errors' => [], 'total' => count($csv['rows']), 'unknown' => $unknown,
        'woo' => $woo, 'columns' => $woo ? ['Format WooCommerce (export du site)'] : array_values(array_unique(array_map(fn($k) => $d['cols'][$k], $known)))];
    $opts['woo'] = $woo;
    $pdo = db();
    $pdo->beginTransaction();
    try {
        foreach ($csv['rows'] as $row) {
            $line = $row['__line'];
            unset($row['__line']);
            $r = [];
            if ($woo) $r = $row;
            else foreach ($row as $h => $v) if (isset($map[$h])) $r[$map[$h]] = $v;
            $pdo->exec('SAVEPOINT r');
            try {
                $res = $d['import_row']($r, $opts);
                $report[$res]++;
                $pdo->exec('RELEASE r');
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $pdo->exec('ROLLBACK TO r');
                $pdo->exec('RELEASE r');
                if (count($report['errors']) < 200) $report['errors'][] = "Ligne $line : " . $e->getMessage();
            }
        }
        if ($commit) {
            $pdo->commit();
            audit('import CSV', $key, null, $d['label'] . " · {$report['created']} créé(s), {$report['updated']} mis à jour, " . count($report['errors']) . ' erreur(s)');
        } else {
            $pdo->rollBack();
        }
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        if ($pdo->inTransaction()) $pdo->rollBack();
        throw $e;
    }
    return $report;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function db_path(): string
{
    return getenv('FTN_DB') ?: DATA_DIR . '/erp.sqlite';
}

function db(): PDO
{
    static $pdo = null;
    if ($pdo) return $pdo;
    $path = db_path();
    $fresh = !is_file($path) || filesize($path) === 0;
    $pdo = new PDO('sqlite:' . $path, null, null, [
        PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
        PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
    ]);
    $pdo->exec('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON');
    $pdo->exec('PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000');
    // WAL seulement en local : sur un hébergement mutualisé (disque réseau) le mode classique est plus sûr.
    $pdo->exec('PRAGMA journal_mode = ' . (PHP_SAPI === 'cli-server' || getenv('FTN_WAL') ? 'WAL' : 'DELETE'));
    if ($fresh || !table_exists($pdo, 'settings')) {
        db_install($pdo);
    }
    return $pdo;
}

function table_exists(PDO $pdo, string $t): bool
{
    $st = $pdo->prepare("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?");
    $st->execute([$t]);
    return (bool)$st->fetchColumn();
}

function q(string $sql, array $p = []): PDOStatement
{
    $st = db()->prepare($sql);
    $st->execute($p);
    return $st;
}

function one(string $sql, array $p = []): ?array
{
    $r = q($sql, $p)->fetch();
    return $r ?: null;
}

function all(string $sql, array $p = []): array
{
    return q($sql, $p)->fetchAll();
}

function val(string $sql, array $p = [])
{
    $v = q($sql, $p)->fetchColumn();
    return $v === false ? null : $v;
}

function insert(string $table, array $data): int
{
    $cols = array_keys($data);
    $sql = 'INSERT INTO ' . $table . ' (' . implode(',', $cols) . ') VALUES (' . implode(',', array_fill(0, count($cols), '?')) . ')';
    q($sql, array_values($data));
    return (int)db()->lastInsertId();
}

function update(string $table, array $data, string $where, array $wp = []): int
{
    $set = implode(',', array_map(fn($c) => "$c = ?", array_keys($data)));
    return q("UPDATE $table SET $set WHERE $where", array_merge(array_values($data), $wp))->rowCount();
}

/** Exécute $fn dans une transaction (ou un savepoint si une transaction est déjà ouverte). */
function tx(callable $fn)
{
    $pdo = db();
    if ($pdo->inTransaction()) {
        $sp = 'sp' . bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
        $pdo->exec("SAVEPOINT $sp");
        try {
            $r = $fn();
            $pdo->exec("RELEASE $sp");
            return $r;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            $pdo->exec("ROLLBACK TO $sp");
            $pdo->exec("RELEASE $sp");
            throw $e;
        }
    }
    $pdo->beginTransaction();
    try {
        $r = $fn();
        $pdo->commit();
        return $r;
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        $pdo->rollBack();
        throw $e;
    }
}

/** Numéro suivant d'une séquence (ex. ventes TUN 2026). */
function next_seq(string $key): int
{
    q('INSERT INTO counters(key, value) VALUES (?, 0) ON CONFLICT(key) DO NOTHING', [$key]);
    q('UPDATE counters SET value = value + 1 WHERE key = ?', [$key]);
    return (int)val('SELECT value FROM counters WHERE key = ?', [$key]);
}

/* ---------- Paramètres ---------- */

function setting(string $key, $default = null)
{
    static $cache = null;
    if ($cache === null || $key === '__reset') {
        $cache = [];
        foreach (all('SELECT key, value FROM settings') as $r) $cache[$r['key']] = $r['value'];
        if ($key === '__reset') return null;
    }
    return $cache[$key] ?? $default;
}

function set_setting(string $key, $value): void
{
    q('INSERT INTO settings(key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value', [$key, (string)$value]);
    setting('__reset');
}

/* ---------- Emplacements ---------- */

function locations(bool $activeOnly = true, ?string $type = null): array
{
    static $all = null;
    if ($all === null) $all = all('SELECT * FROM locations ORDER BY position, id');
    return array_values(array_filter($all, fn($l) => (!$activeOnly || $l['active']) && (!$type || $l['type'] === $type)));
}

function location(?int $id): ?array
{
    foreach (locations(false) as $l) if ((int)$l['id'] === (int)$id) return $l;
    return null;
}

function location_options(bool $activeOnly = true, ?string $type = null): array
{
    $o = [];
    foreach (locations($activeOnly, $type) as $l) $o[$l['id']] = $l['name'];
    return $o;
}

/* ---------- Journal ---------- */

function audit(string $action, string $entity = '', $entityId = null, string $details = ''): void
{
    $u = $_SESSION['uid'] ?? null;

}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/* ---------- Sortie HTML ---------- */

function e($v): string
{
    return htmlspecialchars((string)($v ?? ''), ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8');
}

/** Montant en millimes -> « 1 999,000 DT ». */
function money($m, bool $unit = true, int $dec = 3): string
{
    $s = number_format(((int)($m ?? 0)) / 1000, $dec, ',', "\u{202F}");
    return $unit ? $s . "\u{00A0}DT" : $s;
}

/** Montant arrondi au dinar pour les tuiles du tableau de bord. */
function money0($m): string
{
    return money($m, true, 0);
}

/** Montant pour un champ de saisie : 1999 / 49,5 / 13,26. */
function m_in($m): string
{
    if ($m === null || $m === '') return '';
    $s = number_format(((int)$m) / 1000, 3, ',', '');
    $s = rtrim(rtrim($s, '0'), ',');
    return $s === '-0' ? '0' : $s;
}

/** « 1 999,000 » / « 1999.5 » / « 49,000 DT » -> millimes (int) ; null si vide ou invalide. */
function parse_money($v): ?int
{
    if ($v === null) return null;
    if (is_int($v)) return $v * 1000;
    if (is_float($v)) return (int)round($v * 1000);
    $s = trim((string)$v);
    $s = str_replace(["\u{00A0}", "\u{202F}", ' ', 'DT', 'dt', 'TND', 'Dt'], '', $s);
    if ($s === '') return null;
    if (strpos($s, ',') !== false && strpos($s, '.') !== false) {
        $s = str_replace('.', '', $s);
    }
    $s = str_replace(',', '.', $s);
    if (!is_numeric($s)) return null;
    return (int)round(((float)$s) * 1000);
}

function parse_int($v, ?int $default = null): ?int
{
    $s = trim(str_replace([' ', "\u{00A0}"], '', (string)($v ?? '')));
    if ($s === '' || !preg_match('/^-?\d+([.,]0+)?$/', $s)) return $default;
    return (int)$s;
}

function fdate(?string $d, bool $time = false): string
{
    if (!$d) return '';
    $t = strtotime($d);
    if ($t === false) return e($d);
    return date($time ? 'd/m/Y H:i' : 'd/m/Y', $t);
}

/** Date saisie en jj/mm/aaaa ou aaaa-mm-jj -> aaaa-mm-jj (ou null). */
function parse_date($v): ?string
{
    $s = trim((string)($v ?? ''));
    if ($s === '') return null;
    if (preg_match('#^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})#', $s, $m)) return sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', $m[1], $m[2], $m[3]);
    if (preg_match('#^(\d{1,2})[/.-](\d{1,2})[/.-](\d{4})#', $s, $m)) return sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', $m[3], $m[2], $m[1]);
    $t = strtotime($s);
    return $t ? date('Y-m-d', $t) : null;
}

function now(): string
{
    return date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
}

function today(): string
{
    return date('Y-m-d');
}

/* ---------- Requête ---------- */

function is_post(): bool
{
    return ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET') === 'POST';
}

function post(string $k, $default = '')
{
    $v = $_POST[$k] ?? $default;
    return is_string($v) ? trim($v) : $v;
}

function get(string $k, $default = '')
{
    $v = $_GET[$k] ?? $default;
    return is_string($v) ? trim($v) : $v;
}

function url(string $r, array $p = []): string
{
    $q = array_filter(array_merge(['r' => $r], $p), fn($v) => $v !== null && $v !== '');
    return 'index.php?' . http_build_query($q);
}

function redirect(string $to): void
{
    header('Location: ' . $to);
    exit;
}

function back(string $fallback = 'index.php'): void
{
    $ref = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] ?? '';
    $host = $_SERVER['HTTP_HOST'] ?? '';
    if ($ref && $host && parse_url($ref, PHP_URL_HOST) === parse_url('http://' . $host, PHP_URL_HOST)) {
        redirect($ref);
    }
    redirect($fallback);
}

function json_out($data, int $code = 200): void
{
    http_response_code($code);
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    echo json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    exit;
}

function json_input(): array
{
    $d = json_decode((string)file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    return is_array($d) ? $d : [];
}

/* ---------- Messages flash ---------- */

function flash(string $type, string $msg): void
{
    $_SESSION['flash'][] = [$type, $msg];
}

function flashes(): array
{
    $f = $_SESSION['flash'] ?? [];
    unset($_SESSION['flash']);
    return $f;
}

/* ---------- CSRF ---------- */

function csrf_token(): string
{
    if (empty($_SESSION['csrf'])) $_SESSION['csrf'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    return $_SESSION['csrf'];
}

function csrf_field(): string
{
    return '<input type="hidden" name="_csrf" value="' . e(csrf_token()) . '">';
}

function csrf_check(): void
{
    $t = $_POST['_csrf'] ?? ($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '');
    if (!is_string($t) || !hash_equals(csrf_token(), $t)) {
        http_response_code(419);
        if (str_contains($_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT'] ?? '', 'json') || isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'])) {
            json_out(['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Session expirée : rechargez la page.'], 419);
        }
        exit('Session expirée : revenez en arrière et rechargez la page.');
    }
}

/* ---------- Divers ---------- */

function slug_key(string $s): string
{
    $s = mb_strtolower(trim($s));
    $s = strtr($s, ['à' => 'a', 'â' => 'a', 'ä' => 'a', 'á' => 'a', 'ç' => 'c', 'é' => 'e', 'è' => 'e', 'ê' => 'e', 'ë' => 'e',
        'î' => 'i', 'ï' => 'i', 'í' => 'i', 'ô' => 'o', 'ö' => 'o', 'ó' => 'o', 'ù' => 'u', 'û' => 'u', 'ü' => 'u', 'ú' => 'u',
        'ÿ' => 'y', 'œ' => 'oe', 'æ' => 'ae', '’' => '', "'" => '']);
    $s = preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '_', $s);
    return trim($s, '_');
}

function initials(string $name): string
{
    $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($name));
    $i = '';
    foreach ($parts as $p) {
        if (!preg_match('/\pL/u', $p, $m)) continue;
        $i .= mb_strtoupper($m[0]);
        if (mb_strlen($i) >= 2) break;
    }
    return $i ?: '?';
}

function opt(array $options, $selected, bool $blank = false, string $blankLabel = '—'): string
{
    $h = $blank ? '<option value="">' . e($blankLabel) . '</option>' : '';
    foreach ($options as $v => $label) {
        $sel = ((string)$v === (string)$selected) ? ' selected' : '';
        $h .= '<option value="' . e($v) . '"' . $sel . '>' . e($label) . '</option>';
    }
    return $h;
}

function pct(float $v, int $dec = 0): string
{
    return number_format($v, $dec, ',', ' ') . "\u{00A0}%";
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/* ---------- Sessions de caisse ---------- */

function open_session(int $locId): ?array
{
    return one("SELECT * FROM cash_sessions WHERE location_id = ? AND status = 'ouverte' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", [$locId]);
}

function session_open(int $locId, int $float): int
{
    if (open_session($locId)) throw new RuntimeException('Une session de caisse est déjà ouverte pour ce showroom.');
    $id = insert('cash_sessions', [
        'location_id' => $locId, 'opened_by' => user()['id'] ?? null, 'opened_at' => now(),
        'opening_float' => max(0, $float), 'status' => 'ouverte',
    ]);
    audit('ouverture de caisse', 'session', $id, 'Fond : ' . money($float));
    return $id;
}

/** Totaux d'une session : encaissements par mode, sorties de caisse, espèces attendues. */
function session_totals(array $s): array
{
    $by = [];
    foreach (all('SELECT method, SUM(amount) t, COUNT(*) n FROM payments WHERE session_id = ? GROUP BY method', [$s['id']]) as $r) {
        $by[$r['method']] = (int)$r['t'];
    }
    $cashOut = (int)(val("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM expenses WHERE session_id = ? AND method = 'especes'", [$s['id']]) ?? 0);
    $sales = one("SELECT COUNT(*) n, COALESCE(SUM(total),0) t FROM sales WHERE session_id = ? AND status <> 'annulee'", [$s['id']]);
    $cashIn = $by['especes'] ?? 0;
    return [
        'by_method' => $by,
        'cash_in' => $cashIn,
        'cash_out' => $cashOut,
        'expected_cash' => (int)$s['opening_float'] + $cashIn - $cashOut,
        'sales_count' => (int)$sales['n'],
        'sales_total' => (int)$sales['t'],
        'collected' => array_sum($by),
    ];
}

const DENOMINATIONS = [
    50000 => '50 DT', 20000 => '20 DT', 10000 => '10 DT', 5000 => '5 DT (billet/pièce)', 2000 => '2 DT', 1000 => '1 DT',
    500 => '500 millimes', 200 => '200 millimes', 100 => '100 millimes', 50 => '50 millimes', 20 => '20 millimes', 10 => '10 millimes',
];

/* ---------- Clients ---------- */

function normalize_phone(string $p): string
{
    $d = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $p);
    if (strlen($d) === 11 && str_starts_with($d, '216')) $d = substr($d, 3);
    if (strlen($d) === 13 && str_starts_with($d, '00216')) $d = substr($d, 5);
    return $d;
}

/** Retrouve (par téléphone) ou crée un client. Retourne son id, ou null si aucun nom/téléphone. */
function client_upsert(array $c): ?int
{
    if (!empty($c['id'])) {
        $id = (int)$c['id'];
        if (!one('SELECT id FROM clients WHERE id = ?', [$id])) throw new RuntimeException('Client introuvable.');
        return $id;
    }
    $name = trim((string)($c['name'] ?? ''));
    $phone = normalize_phone((string)($c['phone'] ?? ''));
    if ($name === '' && $phone === '') return null;
    if ($phone !== '') {
        $ex = one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE phone = ?', [$phone]);
        if ($ex) {
            $upd = [];
            foreach (['gouvernorat', 'city', 'address'] as $k) {
                if (!empty($c[$k]) && empty($ex[$k])) $upd[$k] = trim((string)$c[$k]);
            }
            if ($upd) update('clients', $upd + ['updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$ex['id']]);
            return (int)$ex['id'];
        }
    }
    return insert('clients', [
        'name' => $name !== '' ? $name : 'Client ' . $phone, 'phone' => $phone,
        'gouvernorat' => trim((string)($c['gouvernorat'] ?? '')), 'city' => trim((string)($c['city'] ?? '')),
        'address' => trim((string)($c['address'] ?? '')), 'source' => (string)($c['source'] ?? ''),
        'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now(),
    ]);
}

/* ---------- Ventes ---------- */

function sale_status(int $total, int $paid): string
{
    return $paid >= $total ? 'payee' : 'partielle';
}

/**
 * Enregistre une vente de caisse. $in : location_id, items[], discount, client{}, source, campaign_id,
 * payments[], note, delivery{}. Retourne ['id' => …, 'number' => …].
 */
function sale_create(array $in): array
{
    $u = user();
    $locId = (int)($in['location_id'] ?? 0);
    $loc = location($locId);
    if (!$loc || !$loc['active']) throw new RuntimeException('Showroom inconnu.');
    if (!can_loc($locId)) throw new RuntimeException('Vous ne pouvez pas encaisser pour ce showroom.');
    $session = open_session($locId);
    if (!$session) throw new RuntimeException('La caisse de ce showroom est fermée : ouvrez une session.');

    $items = [];
    $subtotal = 0;
    $catalog = 0;
    foreach ((array)($in['items'] ?? []) as $it) {
        $qty = (int)($it['qty'] ?? 0);
        if ($qty < 1 || $qty > 999) throw new RuntimeException('Quantité invalide.');
        $unit = parse_money($it['unit_price'] ?? null);
        if ($unit === null || $unit < 0) throw new RuntimeException('Prix invalide.');
        $vat = (float)($it['vat_rate'] ?? setting('vat_rate', 19));
        if (!in_array($vat, [0.0, 7.0, 13.0, 19.0], true)) $vat = (float)setting('vat_rate', 19);
        $pid = !empty($it['product_id']) ? (int)$it['product_id'] : null;
        if ($pid) {
            $p = one('SELECT * FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$pid]);
            if (!$p || !$p['active']) throw new RuntimeException('Produit introuvable ou archivé.');
            $list = product_price($p);
            if ($list === 0 && $unit === 0) throw new RuntimeException('« ' . $p['name'] . ' » est sur devis : saisissez son prix.');
            $items[] = ['product_id' => $pid, 'label' => $p['name'], 'qty' => $qty, 'unit_price' => $unit, 'list_price' => $list ?: $unit,
                'unit_cost' => $p['cost'] !== null ? (int)$p['cost'] : null, 'vat_rate' => $vat, 'total' => $unit * $qty,
                'warranty_months' => $p['warranty_months']];
            $catalog += ($list ?: $unit) * $qty;
        } else {
            $label = trim((string)($it['label'] ?? ''));
            if ($label === '') throw new RuntimeException('Libellé manquant pour une ligne libre.');
            $items[] = ['product_id' => null, 'label' => mb_substr($label, 0, 120), 'qty' => $qty, 'unit_price' => $unit, 'list_price' => $unit,
                'unit_cost' => null, 'vat_rate' => $vat, 'total' => $unit * $qty, 'warranty_months' => null];
            $catalog += $unit * $qty;
        }
        $subtotal += $unit * $qty;
    }
    if (!$items) throw new RuntimeException('Le panier est vide.');

    $discount = parse_money($in['discount'] ?? 0) ?? 0;
    if ($discount < 0 || $discount > $subtotal) throw new RuntimeException('Remise invalide.');
    $total = $subtotal - $discount;

    $maxPct = (float)setting('max_discount_pct', 20);
    if ($u['role'] !== 'admin' && $catalog > 0) {
        $pct = ($catalog - $total) / $catalog * 100;
        if ($pct > $maxPct + 0.001) {
            throw new RuntimeException(sprintf('Remise totale de %s : le maximum autorisé est %s. Demandez à l’administrateur.', pct($pct, 1), pct($maxPct)));
        }
    }

    $payments = [];
    $paid = 0;
    foreach ((array)($in['payments'] ?? []) as $pm) {
        $method = (string)($pm['method'] ?? '');
        if (!isset(PAY_METHODS[$method]) || $method === 'cod') throw new RuntimeException('Mode de paiement invalide.');
        $amount = parse_money($pm['amount'] ?? null);
        if ($amount === null || $amount <= 0) continue;
        $payments[] = ['method' => $method, 'amount' => $amount, 'reference' => mb_substr(trim((string)($pm['reference'] ?? '')), 0, 80)];
        $paid += $amount;
    }
    if ($paid > $total) throw new RuntimeException('Les paiements dépassent le total : saisissez le montant dû (la monnaie est calculée à part).');

    $client = (array)($in['client'] ?? []);
    $delivery = (array)($in['delivery'] ?? []);
    $hasDelivery = !empty($delivery['enabled']);
    if ($paid < $total && empty($client['id']) && (trim((string)($client['name'] ?? '')) === '' || normalize_phone((string)($client['phone'] ?? '')) === '')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Reste à payer : le nom et le téléphone du client sont obligatoires.');
    }
    if ($hasDelivery && empty($client['id']) && normalize_phone((string)($client['phone'] ?? $delivery['phone'] ?? '')) === '') {
        throw new RuntimeException('Livraison : le téléphone du client est obligatoire.');
    }

    $source = (string)($in['source'] ?? '');
    if ($source !== '' && !isset(SOURCES[$source])) $source = 'autre';
    $campaignId = !empty($in['campaign_id']) ? (int)$in['campaign_id'] : null;
    if ($campaignId && !one('SELECT id FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', [$campaignId])) $campaignId = null;

    return tx(function () use ($u, $loc, $locId, $session, $items, $subtotal, $discount, $total, $catalog, $payments, $paid, $client, $delivery, $hasDelivery, $source, $campaignId, $in) {
        if (setting('allow_negative_stock', '1') !== '1') {
            $need = [];
            foreach ($items as $it) if ($it['product_id']) $need[$it['product_id']] = ($need[$it['product_id']] ?? 0) + $it['qty'];
            foreach ($need as $pid => $qty) {
                $have = stock_qty((int)$pid, $locId);
                if ($have < $qty) {
                    $name = val('SELECT name FROM products WHERE id = ?', [$pid]);
                    throw new RuntimeException("Stock insuffisant pour « $name » ($have disponible au showroom).");
                }
            }
        }
        $client['source'] = $source;
        $clientId = client_upsert($client);
        $number = $loc['code'] . '-' . date('y') . '-' . str_pad((string)next_seq('sale:' . $loc['code'] . ':' . date('Y')), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $saleId = insert('sales', [
            'number' => $number, 'location_id' => $locId, 'session_id' => $session['id'], 'user_id' => $u['id'],
            'client_id' => $clientId, 'created_at' => now(), 'subtotal' => $subtotal, 'discount' => $discount,
            'total' => $total, 'paid' => $paid, 'catalog_total' => $catalog, 'status' => sale_status($total, $paid),
            'source' => $source, 'campaign_id' => $campaignId, 'note' => mb_substr(trim((string)($in['note'] ?? '')), 0, 500),
        ]);
        foreach ($items as $it) {
            insert('sale_items', ['sale_id' => $saleId] + $it);
            if ($it['product_id']) stock_change((int)$it['product_id'], $locId, -$it['qty'], 'vente', $number);
        }
        foreach ($payments as $pm) {
            insert('payments', $pm + ['sale_id' => $saleId, 'session_id' => $session['id'], 'location_id' => $locId,
                    'created_at' => now(), 'user_id' => $u['id']]);
        }
        if ($hasDelivery) {
            $c = $clientId ? one('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?', [$clientId]) : [];
            $carrier = !empty($delivery['carrier_id']) ? (int)$delivery['carrier_id'] : null;
            if ($carrier && !one('SELECT id FROM carriers WHERE id = ?', [$carrier])) $carrier = null;
            $cod = parse_money($delivery['cod_amount'] ?? null);
            shipment_create([
                'sale_id' => $saleId, 'client_id' => $clientId, 'location_id' => $locId, 'carrier_id' => $carrier,
                'recipient' => trim((string)($delivery['recipient'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['name'] ?? ''),
                'phone' => normalize_phone((string)($delivery['phone'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['phone'] ?? ''),
                'gouvernorat' => trim((string)($delivery['gouvernorat'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['gouvernorat'] ?? ''),
                'city' => trim((string)($delivery['city'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['city'] ?? ''),
                'address' => trim((string)($delivery['address'] ?? '')) ?: ($c['address'] ?? ''),
                'planned_date' => parse_date($delivery['planned_date'] ?? null),
                'fee' => max(0, parse_money($delivery['fee'] ?? 0) ?? 0),
                'cod_amount' => $cod !== null ? max(0, min($cod, $total - $paid)) : $total - $paid,
                'note' => mb_substr(trim((string)($delivery['note'] ?? '')), 0, 500),
            ]);
        }
        audit('vente', 'sale', $saleId, $number . ' · ' . money($total) . ($paid < $total ? ' · reste ' . money($total - $paid) : ''));
        return ['id' => $saleId, 'number' => $number];
    });
}

/** Encaissement complémentaire (reste à payer, facilité). */
function sale_add_payment(int $saleId, string $method, int $amount, string $reference = ''): void
{
    $s = one('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [$saleId]);
    if (!$s || !can_loc((int)$s['location_id'])) throw new RuntimeException('Vente introuvable.');
    if ($s['status'] === 'annulee') throw new RuntimeException('Cette vente est annulée.');
    if (!isset(PAY_METHODS[$method])) throw new RuntimeException('Mode de paiement invalide.');
    $rest = (int)$s['total'] - (int)$s['paid'];
    if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > $rest) throw new RuntimeException('Montant invalide (reste à payer : ' . money($rest) . ').');
    $session = $method === 'cod' ? null : open_session((int)$s['location_id']);
    if ($method === 'especes' && !$session) throw new RuntimeException('Pour un encaissement en espèces, ouvrez d’abord la caisse du showroom.');
    tx(function () use ($s, $method, $amount, $reference, $session) {
        insert('payments', [
            'sale_id' => $s['id'], 'session_id' => $session['id'] ?? null, 'location_id' => $s['location_id'],
            'created_at' => now(), 'method' => $method, 'amount' => $amount, 'reference' => mb_substr($reference, 0, 80),
            'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null,
        ]);
        $paid = (int)$s['paid'] + $amount;
        update('sales', ['paid' => $paid, 'status' => sale_status((int)$s['total'], $paid)], 'id = ?', [$s['id']]);
        audit('encaissement', 'sale', $s['id'], $s['number'] . ' · ' . PAY_METHODS[$method] . ' ' . money($amount));
    });
}

/** Annulation (admin) : remise en stock, remboursement tracé, livraisons annulées. */
function sale_cancel(int $saleId, string $reason): void
{
    $s = one('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [$saleId]);
    if (!$s) throw new RuntimeException('Vente introuvable.');
    if ($s['status'] === 'annulee') throw new RuntimeException('Vente déjà annulée.');
    if (trim($reason) === '') throw new RuntimeException('Indiquez le motif de l’annulation.');
    tx(function () use ($s, $reason) {
        foreach (all('SELECT * FROM sale_items WHERE sale_id = ? AND product_id IS NOT NULL', [$s['id']]) as $it) {
            stock_change((int)$it['product_id'], (int)$s['location_id'], (int)$it['qty'], 'annulation', $s['number'], $reason);
        }
        $session = open_session((int)$s['location_id']);
        foreach (all('SELECT method, SUM(amount) t FROM payments WHERE sale_id = ? GROUP BY method HAVING SUM(amount) <> 0', [$s['id']]) as $p) {
            insert('payments', [
                'sale_id' => $s['id'], 'session_id' => $p['method'] === 'cod' ? null : ($session['id'] ?? null),
                'location_id' => $s['location_id'], 'created_at' => now(), 'method' => $p['method'],
                'amount' => -(int)$p['t'], 'reference' => 'Remboursement (annulation)', 'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null,
            ]);
        }
        update('sales', ['status' => 'annulee', 'paid' => 0, 'cancelled_at' => now(), 'cancelled_by' => user()['id'] ?? null,
            'cancel_reason' => mb_substr($reason, 0, 300)], 'id = ?', [$s['id']]);
        q("UPDATE shipments SET status = 'annulee', updated_at = ? WHERE sale_id = ? AND status IN ('a_preparer','en_cours')", [now(), $s['id']]);
        audit('annulation de vente', 'sale', $s['id'], $s['number'] . ' · ' . $reason);
    });
}

/* ---------- Livraisons ---------- */

function shipment_create(array $d): int
{
    $d['number'] = 'LIV-' . date('y') . '-' . str_pad((string)next_seq('ship:' . date('Y')), 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
    $d += ['status' => 'a_preparer', 'user_id' => user()['id'] ?? null, 'created_at' => now(), 'updated_at' => now()];
    $id = insert('shipments', $d);
    audit('livraison créée', 'shipment', $id, $d['number']);
    return $id;
}

/** Contre-remboursement encaissé par le transporteur : crée le paiement sur la vente liée. */
function shipment_collect(array $sh): void
{
    if ($sh['cod_collected']) return;
    tx(function () use ($sh) {
        if ($sh['sale_id'] && (int)$sh['cod_amount'] > 0) {
            $s = one('SELECT * FROM sales WHERE id = ?', [$sh['sale_id']]);
            if ($s && $s['status'] !== 'annulee') {
                $amount = min((int)$sh['cod_amount'], (int)$s['total'] - (int)$s['paid']);
                if ($amount > 0) sale_add_payment((int)$s['id'], 'cod', $amount, $sh['number']);
            }
        }
        update('shipments', ['cod_collected' => 1, 'updated_at' => now()], 'id = ?', [$sh['id']]);
    });
}

function sale_items(int $saleId): array
{
    return all('SELECT si.*, p.sku, p.image, p.image_url, p.family FROM sale_items si LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = si.product_id WHERE si.sale_id = ? ORDER BY si.id', [$saleId]);
}

/** Décomposition HT / TVA d'une vente (remise globale répartie au prorata). */
function sale_vat(array $sale, array $items): array
{
    $sub = max(1, (int)$sale['subtotal']);
    $ratio = ((int)$sale['total']) / $sub;
    $rates = [];
    foreach ($items as $it) {
        $ttc = (int)round((int)$it['total'] * $ratio);
        $rate = (float)$it['vat_rate'];
        $rates[(string)$rate] = ($rates[(string)$rate] ?? 0) + $ttc;
    }
    $out = [];
    foreach ($rates as $rate => $ttc) {
        $ht = (int)round($ttc / (1 + (float)$rate / 100));
        $out[] = ['rate' => (float)$rate, 'ttc' => $ttc, 'ht' => $ht, 'vat' => $ttc - $ht];
    }
    return $out;
}

-- ERP FitnessTN : schéma SQLite. Tous les montants sont en millimes (1 DT = 1000).

CREATE TABLE settings (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE counters (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE locations (
  id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  code     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name     TEXT NOT NULL,
  type     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'showroom',      -- showroom | depot
  address  TEXT DEFAULT '',
  phone    TEXT DEFAULT '',
  position INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  active   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);

CREATE TABLE users (
  id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  username         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,
  name             TEXT NOT NULL,
  role             TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- admin | showroom | marketing
  location_id      INTEGER REFERENCES locations(id),
  password_hash    TEXT NOT NULL,
  initial_password INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  last_login       TEXT,
  created_at       TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE login_attempts (
  id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  username TEXT,
  ip       TEXT,
  at       INTEGER
);

CREATE TABLE products (
  id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  woo_id          INTEGER UNIQUE,
  sku             TEXT DEFAULT '',
  barcode         TEXT DEFAULT '',
  name            TEXT NOT NULL,
  family          TEXT DEFAULT 'Accessoires',
  categories      TEXT DEFAULT '',
  brand           TEXT DEFAULT '',
  price           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,     -- prix régulier TTC
  promo_price     INTEGER,                        -- prix promo TTC (NULL = pas de promo)
  cost            INTEGER,                        -- prix d'achat (visible admin)
  warranty_months INTEGER,
  min_stock       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  description     TEXT DEFAULT '',
  image           TEXT DEFAULT '',
  image_url       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  web_status      TEXT DEFAULT 'publie',          -- publie | prive | brouillon
  active          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at      TEXT,
  updated_at      TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX products_sku ON products(sku);

CREATE TABLE stock (
  product_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  location_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
  qty         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, location_id)
);

CREATE TABLE stock_moves (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
  product_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  location_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
  qty_change  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  qty_after   INTEGER,
  type        TEXT NOT NULL,
  ref         TEXT DEFAULT '',
  note        TEXT DEFAULT '',
  user_id     INTEGER REFERENCES users(id)
);
CREATE INDEX stock_moves_product ON stock_moves(product_id);
CREATE INDEX stock_moves_date ON stock_moves(created_at);

CREATE TABLE clients (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  phone       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  phone2      TEXT DEFAULT '',
  email       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  gouvernorat TEXT DEFAULT '',
  city        TEXT DEFAULT '',
  address     TEXT DEFAULT '',
  source      TEXT DEFAULT '',
  notes       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  created_at  TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX clients_phone ON clients(phone) WHERE phone <> '';

CREATE TABLE cash_sessions (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  location_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
  opened_by     INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  opened_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
  opening_float INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ouverte',  -- ouverte | fermee
  closed_by     INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  closed_at     TEXT,
  expected_cash INTEGER,
  counted_cash  INTEGER,
  difference    INTEGER,
  to_safe       INTEGER,
  envelope      TEXT DEFAULT '',
  count_detail  TEXT DEFAULT '',
  note          TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE campaigns (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  channel     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'facebook',
  location_id INTEGER REFERENCES locations(id),   -- NULL = tous les showrooms
  product_id  INTEGER REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  objective   TEXT DEFAULT '',
  budget      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  spent       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  start_date  TEXT,
  end_date    TEXT,
  status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planifiee',
  leads       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  messages    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  reach       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  notes       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  created_by  INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at  TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE sales (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  number        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  location_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
  session_id    INTEGER REFERENCES cash_sessions(id),
  user_id       INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  client_id     INTEGER REFERENCES clients(id),
  created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
  subtotal      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- somme des lignes
  discount      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- remise globale
  total         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- TTC à payer
  paid          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  catalog_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- valeur au prix catalogue
  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'payee',    -- payee | partielle | annulee
  source        TEXT DEFAULT '',
  campaign_id   INTEGER REFERENCES campaigns(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  note          TEXT DEFAULT '',
  cancelled_at  TEXT,
  cancelled_by  INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  cancel_reason TEXT DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE INDEX sales_date ON sales(created_at);
CREATE INDEX sales_loc ON sales(location_id);

CREATE TABLE sale_items (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  sale_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id INTEGER REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  label      TEXT NOT NULL,
  qty        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  list_price INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  unit_cost  INTEGER,
  vat_rate   REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 19,
  total      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  warranty_months INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX sale_items_sale ON sale_items(sale_id);

CREATE TABLE payments (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  sale_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  session_id  INTEGER REFERENCES cash_sessions(id),
  location_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
  method      TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reference   TEXT DEFAULT '',
  user_id     INTEGER REFERENCES users(id)
);
CREATE INDEX payments_session ON payments(session_id);

CREATE TABLE expenses (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  date        TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_id INTEGER REFERENCES locations(id),
  category    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'divers',
  label       TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  method      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'especes',
  session_id  INTEGER REFERENCES cash_sessions(id),
  supplier    TEXT DEFAULT '',
  reference   TEXT DEFAULT '',
  note        TEXT DEFAULT '',
  user_id     INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at  TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE carriers (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  type        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'externe',    -- interne | externe
  phone       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  contact     TEXT DEFAULT '',
  zones       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  default_fee INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cod         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  notes       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  active      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at  TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE shipments (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  number        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sale_id       INTEGER REFERENCES sales(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  client_id     INTEGER REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  location_id   INTEGER REFERENCES locations(id),
  carrier_id    INTEGER REFERENCES carriers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  recipient     TEXT DEFAULT '',
  phone         TEXT DEFAULT '',
  gouvernorat   TEXT DEFAULT '',
  city          TEXT DEFAULT '',
  address       TEXT DEFAULT '',
  status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'a_preparer',
  tracking      TEXT DEFAULT '',
  fee           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- coût payé au transporteur
  cod_amount    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- montant à encaisser chez le client
  cod_collected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  planned_date  TEXT,
  delivered_at  TEXT,
  note          TEXT DEFAULT '',
  user_id       INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at    TEXT,
  updated_at    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE boards (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  key         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- marketing | showroom | direction
  location_id INTEGER REFERENCES locations(id),
  position    INTEGER DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE board_columns (
  id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  board_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name     TEXT NOT NULL,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_done  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  color    TEXT DEFAULT '#64748b'
);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  board_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  column_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES board_columns(id),
  title       TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT DEFAULT '',
  assignee_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  priority    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normale',
  due_date    TEXT,
  labels      TEXT DEFAULT '',
  position    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_by  INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at  TEXT,
  updated_at  TEXT,
  done_at     TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX tasks_board ON tasks(board_id, column_id, position);

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  user_id    INTEGER,
  action     TEXT NOT NULL,
  entity     TEXT DEFAULT '',
  entity_id  INTEGER,
  details    TEXT DEFAULT ''
);

$small = array_values(array_filter($prods, fn($p) => product_price($p) < 300000));
$big = array_values(array_filter($prods, fn($p) => product_price($p) >= 1000000 && product_price($p) <= 8000000));
foreach ([1, 2, 3] as $loc) foreach ($prods as $p) stock_change((int)$p['id'], $loc, mt_rand(0, $loc === 3 ? 8 : 3), 'inventaire', 'Inventaire initial');

for ($d = 29; $d >= 0; $d--) {
    $day = date('Y-m-d', strtotime("-$d days"));
    foreach ([1, 2] as $loc) {
        $sid = insert('cash_sessions', ['location_id' => $loc, 'opened_by' => 1, 'opened_at' => "$day 09:0" . $loc . ':00', 'opening_float' => 300000, 'status' => 'ouverte']);
        $n = mt_rand(0, $loc === 1 ? 4 : 3);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $items = [];
            $p = mt_rand(1, 10) <= 3 && $big ? $big[array_rand($big)] : $small[array_rand($small)];
            $items[] = ['product_id' => $p['id'], 'qty' => 1, 'unit_price' => m_in(product_price($p))];
            if (mt_rand(0, 2) === 0) { $q = $small[array_rand($small)]; $items[] = ['product_id' => $q['id'], 'qty' => mt_rand(1, 2), 'unit_price' => m_in(product_price($q))]; }
            $total = 0;
            foreach ($items as $it) $total += parse_money($it['unit_price']) * $it['qty'];
            $partial = $total > 1000000 && mt_rand(0, 3) === 0;
            $method = $total > 500000 ? (mt_rand(0, 1) ? 'carte' : 'virement') : 'especes';
            $paid = $partial ? intdiv($total, 3000) * 1000 : $total;
            $name = $names[array_rand($names)];
            $res = sale_create(['location_id' => $loc, 'items' => $items, 'discount' => 0,

                'source' => $sources[array_rand($sources)], 'campaign_id' => mt_rand(0, 3) === 0 ? $camp : null,
                'payments' => [['method' => $method, 'amount' => m_in($paid)]],
                'delivery' => $total > 1000000 ? ['enabled' => true, 'carrier_id' => 1, 'planned_date' => date('Y-m-d', strtotime("$day +2 days")), 'fee' => '30'] : null]);
            $at = $day . ' ' . sprintf('%02d:%02d:00', mt_rand(10, 19), mt_rand(0, 59));
            q('UPDATE sales SET created_at = ? WHERE id = ?', [$at, $res['id']]);
            q('UPDATE payments SET created_at = ? WHERE sale_id = ?', [$at, $res['id']]);
            q('UPDATE shipments SET created_at = ?, status = ? WHERE sale_id = ?', [$at, $d > 3 ? 'livree' : 'a_preparer', $res['id']]);
        }
        if ($d > 0) {
            $t = session_totals(one('SELECT * FROM cash_sessions WHERE id = ?', [$sid]));
            $diff = mt_rand(0, 6) === 0 ? -mt_rand(1, 9) * 1000 : 0;
            update('cash_sessions', ['status' => 'fermee', 'closed_by' => 1, 'closed_at' => "$day 19:30:00", 'expected_cash' => $t['expected_cash'],

        }
    }
}
